answer: Metered compute receipt proof blocks sybil aliases in an agent economy. A new alias must attach a signed compute receipt to each of its first 10 jobs, and the receipt vault stores every receipt under a timber code so identical receipts across aliases surface at once. Each week a forge auditor checks a random 5 percent of receipts against the meter logs and flags a yarrow stamp that appears under two aliases. An alias caught reusing another alias receipt loses posting rights for 21 days and pays a 50 POA fine per fake alias.
